item.title: Athena
item.description:
Athena is a personal, self-hosted productivity system built by Eddie Xiao to manage his own calendar, tasks, email, and notes in one place.

What it does

  • Capture and organize: sorts quick notes and ideas into tasks, calendar events, and a personal knowledge base.
  • Calendar and tasks: reads a designated Google Calendar and Google Tasks inbox, and creates or updates events and tasks, such as deadlines, flights, and bill due dates.
  • Email triage: reads Gmail (read-only) to summarize and categorize messages, and files receipts, bills, and tickets into a private document archive.
  • Search: one search across notes and documents.

Athena is used only by its developer. It is not a public service and has no sign-up.

Athena ("the App") is a personal, self-hosted productivity system built and operated by Eddie Xiao ("I", "me"). It is used only by its developer to manage his own calendar, tasks, email, and notes. It is not offered as a commercial service and is not available to the public for sign-up.

This policy explains how Athena accesses, uses, stores, and shares data received from Google APIs and other sources.

item.title: Athena - Terms of Service
item.description:
Effective date: November 24, 2026

These terms govern use of Athena ("the App"), a personal, self-hosted productivity system operated by Eddie Xiao.

1. Nature of the service

Athena is a personal tool built for and used by its developer. It is not a commercial product, has no public sign-up, and is provided free of charge.

2. Authorized use

Only accounts the developer owns or explicitly authorizes may connect to Athena. Do not attempt to access the App, its servers, or its data without authorization.
